node.title: E22 nested-fiber residual identity
node.statement: For dyadic scales M_i<M_j, with every M_j-fiber a union of M_i-fibers, a support with canonical scale-M_i data is raw-admissible at M_j exactly when the scale-M_i tail plus the selected M_i-fibers whose M_j-parent is not completely selected has total size less than M_j.
node.attack_surface: finite nested-partition identity for canonical full-fiber recovery
node.falsifier: a coarse M_j-fiber fully contained in the support without all of its M_i-children selected, or a wrong residual-tail size formula
